summary: Formats a numeric value into the output buffer a1: writes a leading '-' (45) when the sign flag *a3 equals 45, shifts the buffer to make room, writes the locale decimal separator byte_5E6BD8, and pads with '0' characters for negative exponent spans. Handles a zero-value special case by writing '0' plus a NUL terminator. Returns the buffer start pointer.

operations.description: Zero special case: when flag a4 is set and a3[1]-1 equals a2, write character '0' (48) followed by a NUL terminator at the computed buffer position.
Negative sign: when the sign flag *a3 equals 45, write '-' at the buffer start and advance the write cursor by one.
Branch on the digit count a3[1]: if positive use it as the digit span; otherwise shift the buffer right by one, write '0', and advance the cursor.
StringShiftByOffset moves existing buffer content right to make room for the sign or digit characters.
When a2 is positive, shift the buffer again and write the locale decimal separator byte_5E6BD8 at the current position.
For a negative digit count a3[1], compute the magnitude a2 = -a3[1] as the zero-pad span.
sub_58BB10 fills the buffer region with '0' (0x30) padding over the requested span.
Return the buffer start pointer a1.
